name: East Micronesia Cable (EMC) - Nauru Cable Landing Station
developer: Nauru Fibre Cable Corporation (NFCC) / Naoero Fibre Cable (EMC consortium; NEC supplier)
notes: Cable landed in Nauru 2025-08-09 (AUD135m AIFFP-funded East Micronesia Cable, branch to Pohnpei/HANTRU-1, 100 Gbps initial provisioned capacity). Official NFCC/EMC/AIFFP pages as of 2026-08-12 still say 'just months away from ready for service' with no published RFS confirmation (expected Nov 2025 per 2025 sources; aggregate sources list RFS 2026). ADB Initial Environmental Examination (50348-001-ieeab-02, A-grade) states the cable landing station is proposed at the ICT building in Yaren - tagged to Yaren on that basis; NFCC/EMC public pages do not name a district. Telecom infrastructure, NOT a commercial datacenter; no colocation/interconnection service published by NFCC.

name: Department of ICT - ICT Center (government server room / ICT operations)
developer: Government of Nauru - Department of ICT
notes: Official page confirms Department of ICT located at the ICT Center, Yaren District; operates all government communications/information systems, network/internet/email/web services, 'powerful servers', 26 staff; ITSM framework and continuous IT infrastructure upgrades. Government server-room/ICT lead - not a public/commercial datacenter. National Digital Transformation Strategy (NNDTS 2025 PDF) lists digital government cloud/cybersecurity as planned-policy targets only, not a named facility.

name: Cenpac Net Inc / Nauru Internet Centre (operator server room / ISP)
notes: Official site and IANA .nr delegation confirm Cenpac Net Inc, ISP since 1998, .nr ccTLD registry role, registered at Civic Centre, Aiwo District (AS55722). Operator exchange/server-room lead in Aiwo; no public colocation/rack/hosting product page found - not counted as commercial colocation.

name: Digicel Nauru (mobile operator core/backbone)
notes: Operator presence confirmed (Digicel Pacific Nauru page; DCD reporting quotes Digicel Nauru on EMC backbone access elevating its network 'on par with leading international networks'). No public datacenter/colo site or address identified - kept as operator lead, division Unknown NR.

name: Public cloud regions in Nauru (AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle OCI) - verified negative
notes: Verified negative: no Nauru public cloud region, Local Zone or edge location in official AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI region lists (re-checked 2026-08-12). Hyperscale/AI-HPC campus: no evidence. Recheck official provider pages on each refresh.

name: Commercial colocation / datacenter market in Nauru - verified negative
notes: No verified commercial colocation provider or third-party datacenter in Nauru. Directory-type 'Unknown Nauru Data Center' entries (e.g., dchub.cloud) lack operator/address/corroboration and are Grade C lead-generation artifacts - not counted. Power sanity check: NUC reports ~5-6 MW peak island demand (11.6 MW firm capacity, 5.3 MW max demand in annual report), so any multi-MW DC claim would be nationally material and needs primary power/procurement evidence.
